svg.title: Book of PEACHES
svg.desc: A large warm brown book lies diagonally, decorated with gold corner flourishes and a double gilt border. The complete gold title PEACHES reads upward along the left side of its cover. The spine is lettered Book of PEACHES. A smaller golden-orange, coral-blushed peach with one curling green leaf rests at the lower left, naturally overlapping the book's near corner and spine. Transparent background. Every illustration and letter is vector, with no embedded pictures or required fonts.
